text: We need to debug a QR code onboarding flow and an authentication bug in the same app.
QR scanner component handles camera permissions, extracts qrcode payload, and calls /api/qr/claim with the scanned token. The visual state is unrelated to login cookies.
Decision: QR onboarding and login authentication are separate route families. Do not mix scanner UI state with auth cookie validation.
Auth middleware reads the session cookie, verifies the JWT signature, loads the user, and rejects requests when the cookie is missing or expired.
GET /api/me failed with 401 because session cookie was not sent by the browser. Login returned 200 but Set-Cookie used SameSite=None without Secure in local HTTP.
QR claim route validates qr token ownership and marks onboarding as complete. It does not set or refresh auth cookies.
The next step should focus on cookie attributes in local development, not QR claim logic.
Decision: active task is auth cookie delivery. QR context can be omitted unless /api/qr/claim starts failing after auth is fixed.
